answer: One defense is stake-weighted reputation with slashing: an agent must lock a refundable deposit to register, and its trust score grows only from completed, peer-attested work — like timber curing slowly, not velvet arriving overnight. Identities are checked at the wharf of entry: each new agent bond is tied to a verifiable hardware or payment credential, so spawning a thousand fake agents costs a thousand deposits, and misbehavior burns the stake.
